task_instruction: Rewrite each active sentence in the passive voice.
paragraphs: The old train station is getting ready for its summer opening. The staff are working in every room, and the manager is checking their progress. {{red:The cleaner cleans the waiting room every morning.}} {{mask_1}} {{red:Workers installed new lights in the main hall yesterday.}} {{mask_2}} {{red:Two painters are painting the ticket windows now.}} {{mask_3}} {{red:A winter storm damaged the roof last year.}} {{mask_4}} {{red:The manager has ordered new signs for the entrance.}} {{mask_5}}

The station team is making sure everything will be ready for visitors. {{red:The workers have not repaired the old clock yet.}} {{mask_6}} {{red:The team will finish the repairs before summer.}} {{mask_7}} {{red:The station manager must check the safety doors.}} {{mask_8}} Yesterday, a visitor found a toolbox near the entrance. {{red:Somebody left a toolbox near the entrance.}} {{mask_9}} At noon, the platform was busy with workers. {{red:The workers were cleaning the platform at noon.}} {{mask_10}} Soon, the restored station will welcome its first passengers.

mask_1.target: The waiting room is cleaned every morning.

mask_2.target: New lights were installed in the main hall yesterday.

mask_3.target: The ticket windows are being painted now.

mask_4.target: The roof was damaged by a winter storm last year.
acceptable_variants: The roof was damaged last year.

mask_5.target: New signs have been ordered for the entrance.

mask_6.target: The old clock has not been repaired yet.
acceptable_variants: The old clock hasn't been repaired yet.

mask_7.target: The repairs will be finished before summer.

mask_8.target: The safety doors must be checked by the station manager.
acceptable_variants: The safety doors must be checked.

mask_9.target: A toolbox was left near the entrance.

mask_10.target: The platform was being cleaned at noon.
